definitions: A pop-up menu that appears when a user right-clicks or performs a similar action, displaying options relevant to the specific item or area clicked.
A menu in a graphical user interface that offers a limited set of choices that are available in the current state, or 'context', of the operating system or application to which the menu belongs.
examples: Right-click to open the context menu.
The context menu provides relevant options.
I found the setting in the context menu.
